description: This file is a JavaScript module responsible for managing and executing Vitest test specifications, including locking mechanisms, cleanup procedures, and process spawning for testing workflows.

methods.name: cleanupVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Removes the include file specified in the test spec to clean up temporary files.

methods.name: runVitestSpec
methods.description: Executes a Vitest test specification, handling setup and cleanup, returning a promise with the execution result.

methods.name: createRootVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Creates a default test specification for running Vitest with the provided arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function orchestrating test runs, process management, and lock handling.
